gui.murimblock.profile.name: NAME
gui.murimblock.profile.title: TITLE
gui.murimblock.profile.message: Your strength comes from Qi alone. Cultivate to grow stronger.
gui.murimblock.techniques.notice: Only one martial art flows through your meridians. Switch freely outside combat.
gui.murimblock.techniques.notice_combat: You cannot change your martial art during combat.
murimblock.technique.calm_current.desc: Every third sword strike flows into the next one and costs no time.
murimblock.technique.river_thrust.desc: A long thrust that slides forward a few blocks.
murimblock.technique.whirlpool_cut.desc: A spinning cut that pulls nearby enemies toward you.
murimblock.technique.waterfall_descent.d: Leap and bring the blade down like falling water.
murimblock.technique.thousand_streams.de: The art at its peak: a storm of cuts in every direction.
murimblock.technique.rooted_stance.desc: You are knocked back less while standing still.
murimblock.technique.mountain_breaker.de: A heavy punch that breaks the guard of the target.
murimblock.technique.stone_skin.desc: Hardens the body with Qi and reduces damage for a moment.
murimblock.technique.avalanche.desc: Strike the ground and send a wave of force around you.
murimblock.technique.long_reach.desc: Staff strikes reach one block further.
murimblock.technique.sweeping_arc.desc: A wide sweep that trips the enemies in front of you.
